name: release-check
description: Run three release checks at the same time, then publish only if all three passed. The fan-out shape: several work orders are open at once, so a crew can share them, and nothing ships until every one has reported.

check_security.why: scan the release for known-vulnerable dependencies

check_tests.why: run the test suite against the release candidate

check_licences.why: check every dependency licence is one we allow

publish_release.why: publish the release - the consequential step, and the reason the checks exist
